title: PDSG Edge
description: A directed edge representing causality/flow between PDSG nodes (intent → actuator, actuator → sensor, etc.)

edge_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this edge

source_node_id.description: Source node ID (must exist in PDSG)

target_node_id.description: Target node ID (must exist in PDSG)

created_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when this edge was created

safety_gate_passed.description: Whether the safety gate evaluation passed for this edge (required for actuation edges)

safety_check_id.description: Reference to the safety gate check record that authorized this edge

capability_token_id.description: Capability token that authorized the action this edge represents

parameters.description: Edge-specific parameters (flow rate, duration, trigger conditions, etc.)
